newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - P&O options busy on mixed trading.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - P&O options busy on mixed trading.

text.p: Traded options in Peninsular & Oriental Steam Navigation Co were the centre of attention on Thursday after an adverse newspaper article, dealers said.
Trading attention was focussed on the May and August series of P&O following a report in Lloyd's List newspaper that P&O faces a lawsuit in the U.S. over alleged unfair trading practices.
One of the larger deals in the options was from a buyer of 500 May 600 puts at 21p, who will make money from a further fall in the company's shares.

Another trader bought 450 August 550 puts at prices between 13p to 17p. In contrast -- proabably expecting the share price to bounce back after today's sharp decline -- one trader bought 200 May 700 calls at 4-1/2p.
By 1420 GMT, P&O shares had fallen 25-1/2p to 615p.

Over in British Petroleum there was a seller of 250 April 700 puts at 9p which dealers believe may have been a closing position. There was also a seller of 200 April 700 calls at 17p. BP shares added 4p to 708-1/2p.
Elsewhere, in brewer and distiller Guinness, the main deal was from a buyer of 275 May 460 calls at 58p.
Over in FTSE 100 index options, market makers marked down option premiums in the April series in order to stem interest from any sellers ahead of the long weekend.

And in a shortcovering deal one trader bought back a strangle by buying 1,000 May 4175 puts at 40p as well as 1,000 May 4525 calls at 16p. The original short strangle had been sold for 70p. By 1420, the FTSE 100 index was up 25.6 at 4327.1.
The options market will be closed from Friday through to Monday owing to the Easter Holidays.
